chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: I played All Streams Flow to the Sea on Nibbit, then Thoma - Blazing Ooyoroi and chose Gain 3 Block, applying no element.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered playing All Streams Flow to the Sea and choosing the 8-damage option on Thoma - Blazing Ooyoroi, dealing 17 total damage while taking the full attack.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up 8 damage to reduce the telegraphed 12 damage by 3 Block, leaving Nibbit at 15 HP instead of 7 HP.
q4_different_intent: Yes. If Nibbit had not telegraphed damage, I would have chosen Thoma - Blazing Ooyoroi's 8-damage option instead of 3 Block.
